missions.name: Supplier Lead Time Discrepancies

missions.name: Sizing Anomalies by Category
missions.query: Detect products with a significant deviation in size distribution across different categories.

missions.name: Dead Stock Hotspots
missions.query: Pinpoint locations with a high stock count of dead products.

missions.query: Analyze the frequency and duration of reorder point breaches across different products and suppliers.

missions.query: Identify suppliers with a significant variance in on-time delivery rate compared to their historical average.

missions.name: Product Pricing Anomalies

missions.name: Inventory Turnover Analysis
missions.query: Analyze the inventory turnover rate for each product and supplier to identify slow-moving items.

missions.name: Restocking Efficiency Assessment
missions.query: Evaluate the restocking efficiency of each location by analyzing the time taken to restock products after a reorder point breach.

missions.name: Dead Stock Detection

missions.name: Sizing Anomalies
missions.query: For each category, what is the average size distribution and identify categories with a standard deviation greater than 2?

missions.name: Price Discrepancies

missions.name: Inventory Turnover Rate Analysis
